top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks join a sharply delimited quantum-control principle to independently reproduced 10^-18 performance, creating a mature new regime for controlled precision measurement. Katori and Ye provide the strongest available concept-to-realization attribution, provided the citation remains confined to lattice clocks rather than optical metrology generally.
recusal_note: No conflict with the proposed laureates is apparent. My long-standing collaboration with Anne L'Huillier concerns attosecond physics and does not involve the shortlisted achievement.
